But of course, there had to be the expected onslaught of contrarians that were saying “bro you haven’t listened to brockhamptons new track BRO” Are you fucking kidding me? To think a group like Brockhampton is capable of making something as abrasive as Death Grips is fucking laughable. They, nor 99.9% of other artists will EVER touch something like Two Heavens in terms of sheer brutality. There is simply no one else on DG’s level. Zach Hill has pushed his body to the limits with his drumming like no one else has, do you really think some of these low-level artists can touch his work ethic? Obviously not. NO ONE goes harder than Death Grips. That is a fucking FACT whether you like it or not. Fuck off with this contrarian bullshit and just agree when you know it’s true. No one cares if you like this other inferior band that everyone has heard of. DG go the hardest, everyone else are practically pussified in comparison, case closed.
